This is the signal PubMed structurally cannot produce: a surgeon who operates and
does not publish is invisible to a citation database, but the network that exists
precisely to answer 'where in Europe do I go with this rare disease' names his
hospital. `localAliases` carries the Polish name because ERNs list centres under
their English name and our records hold the local one.
